title: PDD Send Media/Card Capabilities
objective: Freeze a truthful, provenance-qualified report of what is known and unknown about PDD media and card capability subjects without creating an executable platform capability.

evidence_cutoff.later_evidence_rule: Later accepted evidence may supersede only the affected claim; this historical report is not silently rewritten.

confirmed: The reviewed Roadmap names PDD Send Media/Card Capabilities as SHEEP-089 scope.
The repository contains legacy or synthetic vocabulary including send_image, asset_ref, send_product_card, and send_order_card.
SHEEP-065 records that attachment/card fact readiness was blocked and that send_image behavior was an outbound DOM driver rather than an inbound attachment fact source.
SHEEP-088 live evidence establishes a text control case only; its text target and message.type=0 semantics do not establish Media/Card semantics.
No direct accepted PDD evidence in the available scope establishes a Media or Card category, target, payload, upload lifecycle, response, processing, delivery, read, or rendering contract.
inferred: The existing repository vocabulary may be retained as compatibility or fixture context while remaining non-authoritative for PDD Media/Card support.
blocked: A typed executable Media contract is blocked by the absence of one evidenced exact media variant and its target/input/upload/payload/response semantics.
A typed executable Card contract is blocked by the absence of one evidenced exact card category and its target/payload/response semantics.
deferred: Real Media/Card action, platform transport, upload, processing, and future evidence-acquisition units are deferred to separately authorized work.

evidence_records.claimScope: SHEEP-089 is an in-scope knowledge freeze for separate MEDIA and CARD subjects.
evidence_records.evidenceAssessment: The reviewed Roadmap establishes the task subject boundary, not platform support.
evidence_records.limitations: A Roadmap title does not define a wire contract or authorize real platform action.
evidence_records.conclusion: MEDIA and CARD remain separate knowledge subjects; no executable capability is established.

evidence_records.claimScope: Repository terms send_image, asset_ref, send_product_card, and send_order_card exist.
evidence_records.evidenceAssessment: Current Fast Sheep source, tests, and reports contain these terms as legacy/local technical vocabulary.
evidence_records.reference: Fast Sheep repository search and reports/SHEEP-065-report.json
evidence_records.limitations: Artifact existence does not prove PDD support, target semantics, payload shape, upload behavior, response semantics, or production authorization.
evidence_records.conclusion: Retain only as explicitly non-authoritative repository context.

evidence_records.claimScope: PDD text target and message.type=0 semantics.
evidence_records.evidenceAssessment: Accepted SHEEP-081/SHEEP-088 evidence establishes the confirmed text control case only.
evidence_records.limitations: Text evidence does not establish Media/Card target, upload, payload, type, response, processing, delivery, read, or rendering semantics.
evidence_records.conclusion: Text semantics are not inherited by MEDIA or CARD.

evidence_records.evidenceAssessment: No accepted direct live evidence for an exact Media or Card capability is present in this freeze.
evidence_records.limitations: Absence of evidence is not evidence of unsupported capability; no exact capability claim is assigned a support state.
evidence_records.conclusion: Media/Card support remains unestablished and no platform action is authorized.

support_status_model.supported_meaning: Authoritative evidence confirms the exact platform capability claim.
support_status_model.unsupported_meaning: Authoritative evidence confirms the exact capability is unavailable.
support_status_model.unknown_meaning: The exact claim exists but evidence cannot establish support or non-support.
support_status_model.category_not_established_rule: Do not assign a support state to an invented or unestablished category.

readiness_separation.separation_rule: Platform support, runtime readiness, authorization, entitlement, session readiness, and target readiness are distinct dimensions.

text_control_boundary.text_target: PDD_CUSTOMER_UID(customerUid) for the confirmed text contract only

sheep_088_safety_reference.unknown_outcome_rule: UNKNOWN -> NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY for future action contracts

future_typed_contract_gate.conversation_identity: Not automatically required unless the evidenced operation requires it; customerUid remains distinct from conversationId.

future_real_action_gate: local validation and explicit human confirmation
no DELIVERED/READ/rendering claim without direct evidence
